Usage: photoc [global options] sort <directory> --by date [--recursive]
       photoc sort --help

Preview date-based JPEG sorting

Status: dry-run only; no files or directories are changed

Example:
  photoc sort ~/Pictures --by date
  photoc sort ~/Pictures --by date --recursive

Options:
  --by date          Required; group by EXIF capture date (YYYY/MM/DD)
  --recursive        Include nested directories
